framework: SFDA MDS-G010 Guidance on AI and ML technologies based Medical Devices (v1.0, 29/11/2022)
requirement_paraphrase: Analytical validation should use a large independent reference dataset reflecting the intended purpose and population (prevalence, multi-centre sourcing, demographics, justified size, not publicly available), each requirement applying unless there is sufficient evidence that it need not be met; performance should be shown to generalise through multisite investigation and subgroup analysis, and be tested against a gold standard.

framework: SFDA MDS-G010 Guidance on AI and ML technologies based Medical Devices (v1.0, 29/11/2022)
requirement_paraphrase: Effects should be evaluated in clinically relevant conditions integrated into the clinical workflow, comparing clinicians with and without the device; manufacturers should locally validate devices developed and approved in other jurisdictions.
what_is_tested: Real-world clinical effect; local validity in KSA

framework: SDAIA AI Ethics Principles (Version 1.0, September 2023, read on dgp.sdaia.gov.sa; the 2025 edition on sdaia.gov.sa was not readable)
clause_or_page: Annexure A (Ethical Impact Assessment, Algorithm Auditing, Safety Self-Assessment), pp. 34-40
requirement_paraphrase: Describes tools: ethical impact assessments (which can inform whether a model should move to production), systematic and continuous algorithm audits, fairness assessments, and safety self-assessments logged at each lifecycle stage.
what_is_tested: Ethical impact; algorithmic behaviour; accuracy, reliability, security, robustness

requirement_paraphrase: Recommends systematic cybersecurity code review, testing and formal approval of all AI-generated code before use in development, integration or production.

framework: SFDA MDS-G010 Guidance on AI and ML technologies based Medical Devices (v1.0, 29/11/2022)
requirement_paraphrase: SFDA is to be informed via GHAD of significant changes within 10 days; the manufacturer shall have QMS procedures for change control, and all changes shall be evaluated, verified and validated under those procedures.
what_is_tested: Verification and validation of device changes

framework: Canada - Directive on Automated Decision-Making (TBS, amended 2025-06-24)
requirement_paraphrase: Conduct risk assessments during development and maintenance and implement IM/IT security protections per the Policy on Government Security and the Policy on Service and Digital.

framework: Canada - Directive on Automated Decision-Making (TBS, amended 2025-06-24)
requirement_paraphrase: Monitor outcomes of the system on a scheduled basis to guard against unintentional or unfair outcomes and to verify compliance with human-rights obligations, program legislation and the Directive.

framework: Canada - Directive on Automated Decision-Making (TBS, amended 2025-06-24)
requirement_paraphrase: Review, approve and update the published AIA on a scheduled basis, including whenever functionality or scope of the system changes.
what_is_tested: Re-assessment of impact level after change

framework: Canada - Directive on Automated Decision-Making (TBS, amended 2025-06-24)
requirement_paraphrase: If using a proprietary licence, ensure the department keeps the right to access, test and monitor the system and all released versions of proprietary components for audit, investigation, inspection, enforcement or judicial purposes, and may authorise external parties to review, test, monitor and audit them.
what_is_tested: Contractual access for testing and audit of proprietary components
who_tests: Department and any external parties it authorises

framework: NCA 'Draft of AI Cybersecurity Guidelines' (AICG-1:2026), draft for public consultation (closed 5 Aug 2026)
requirement_paraphrase: Assess and manage the cybersecurity of third-party AI components in AI systems before use and on an ongoing basis.
